messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] SE estimates for ZIP models
parts:
Hi Tyler,

Until I find time to implement the delta method for the ZIP models, you can use nonparboot, or parboot like I have done here:

library(unmarked)
example(pcount)
fm2 <- update(fm1, mixture="ZIP")

getEN <- function(m) predict(m, type="state")[,1] # Returns expected value of N at each site
pbEN <- parboot(fm2, getEN, nsim=50) # nsim should be higher
pbEN

cbind(Est=pbEN@t0, SE=apply(pb...@t.star, 2, sd)) # Expected values with SEs


Richard


On Thu, Dec 13, 2012 at 6:45 PM, <tll...@alaska.edu> wrote:
Hi all.
 
I am using pcount to run models with a zero-inflated poisson distribution (ZIP), which fits my data quite well.  However, when I try to get predicted values and associated SE for my models, I get the following warning message:
 "Method to compute SE for ZIP model has not been written"
 
So, I would really, really like to obtain SE estimates for my ZIP models.  Can anybody help with some R code which can be used outside of the unmarked package to provide such estimates?
 
Regards,
Tyler Lewis

messages.author: 1e1f02e079119aa4
messages.subject: Re: SE estimates for ZIP models
parts:
I've been running pcount models with a ZIP distribution, then using predict() and getting SE and CI values just fine:

newData<-data.frame(grid_ID=data$grid_ID,elev=pelev.z,roads=proads.z,forest=data$newlogged_preds)
E.N.bar<-predict(fms,type="state",newdata=newData,appendData=TRUE)

But then yesterday I updated R (to 3.0.0) and unmarked and then re-ran the same models, and now it gives the warning message that Tyler encountered, and the SE and CI columns are filled with NAs.  What could have changed?

Thanks!
